correctness.rationale: Exact u,v recurrences give uniform nonlinear bounds and opposite-tail signs. Contraction proves boundedness for |b|<1/2; inward increments prove boundedness at b=-1/2. At |b|>1/2 a superunit affine inequality produces open escape and a nonzero normalized exponential limit. At b=+1/2 monotone outer amplitudes, exponential mean-coordinate contraction and a nonplateau argument prove escape; summation of the derived asymptotic increment 2a s^2 exp(-s) yields the full logarithmic clock and its universal constant. All quantifiers and both endpoints are proved analytically. The 84/36/6 finite diagnostics and three 600000-step checks merely corroborate.

value.rationale: The motivating primary paper highlights complicated basins and possible attractors at infinity without an all-plane infinity-basin threshold. The full parameter trichotomy identifies a sharp asymmetric pair of neutral endpoints, and the singular endpoint admits a universal two-logarithm escape clock independent of initial conditions. These facts distinguish actual global escape from bounded local chaos and supply a motivated quantitative phase portrait invariant, not merely a textbook finite check.
